summary: Frontend-only validation of the new RIF filter in 'Reporte de Avance' modal for Multi-RIF project prj_e586608e3579. UI block, cascade Tiendas list, Limpiar and PDF download work as expected. However, the 'Vista previa' button does NOT send the selected RIFs to the backend — the matrix table is therefore NOT filtered by RIF, contradicting the feature spec. Also fixed a stray corrupted line at the bottom of the component file that would have caused a runtime ReferenceError.

ui_bugs.issue: applyFilters() omits selRifs from query params. After selecting RIF Brasero (rif_408f1f81) and clicking 'Vista previa', the matrix table still renders 4 store groups ['🏬 Marquez','🏬 Centro','🏬 Altamira','🏬 Altamira'] instead of the expected 2 ('Marquez' y 'Centro'). The cascade only affects the visible Tienda checkbox list, but unless the user manually marks the cascaded stores, the backend receives no `rifs` and no `stores`, so all stores are returned.

When the dialog reopens, setSelBanks/setSelProducts/setSelStores are reset but selRifs is NOT reset. If the modal is closed and reopened, previously selected RIFs persist and the cascade behaves inconsistently with the other filters' reset semantics.

integration_issues.issue: Front passes only banks/products/stores; backend never receives `rifs`, so the rendered matrix ignores the RIF filter. PDF works (downloadPdf already includes selRifs), but the on-screen preview is out of sync with the PDF.

action_items: Fix /app/frontend/src/components/ProjectProgressReportDialog.jsx — add `if (selRifs.length) params.rifs = selRifs.join(',');` inside applyFilters() (after the stores line, mirroring downloadPdf).
Also include setSelRifs([]) in the useEffect reset block (line ~52) so RIF selection is cleared every time the modal opens.
After fix, retest 'Vista previa' with rif_408f1f81 selected — the matrix should show exactly 2 store groups (🏬 Marquez, 🏬 Centro).
critical_code_review_comments: Found and removed a corrupted trailing identifier line `ojectProgressReportDialog;` after `export default ProjectProgressReportDialog;` (last line of the file). Although webpack compiled, this would throw `ReferenceError: ojectProgressReportDialog is not defined` at runtime when the module is evaluated in some build modes. Auto-fixed.

downloadPdf and applyFilters duplicate the params-building logic. Recommend extracting a shared `buildFilterParams()` helper so future filter additions don't drift again (this is exactly how this RIF bug slipped in).

The Tienda filter currently lists duplicate 'Altamira' entries — pre-existing in data (one Altamira per RIF). Not a regression of this change, but consider showing the parent RIF tag next to each Tienda name to disambiguate.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Project prj_e586608e3579 is Multi-RIF with 3 RIFs (rif_408f1f81 Brasero, rif_fe660ab3 Barako, rif_c4d25c69 Carbon). RIF Brasero owns stores Marquez & Centro. Backend GET /projects/{id}/report/avance?rifs=rif_408f1f81 already returns the correct filtered set (validated previously by curl). After the main agent patches applyFilters to forward selRifs, retest by clicking 'Vista previa' with only rif_408f1f81 checked and asserting `page.locator('[data-testid="progress-matrix-table"] tbody tr').filter(has-text=🏬).count() === 2` and labels in ['🏬 Marquez','🏬 Centro'].
rca of the issue: RCA: ProjectProgressReportDialog.applyFilters() (lines 58-64) was added before the RIF feature and was not updated when selRifs was introduced. downloadPdf() WAS updated (line 74 contains `if (selRifs.length) params.rifs = selRifs.join(',');`) which is why PDF filtering works correctly, but the inline 'Vista previa' table does not. Repro: 1) login admin → /projects/prj_e586608e3579 → click 'Reporte de Avance'. 2) Check rif_408f1f81 (Brasero). Observe the Tienda list cascades to {Marquez, Centro} (frontend-only cascade). 3) Click 'Vista previa' without manually checking the Tienda boxes. 4) Observed: matrix renders 4 🏬 store groups (Marquez, Centro, Altamira, Altamira). Expected: 2 (Marquez, Centro). Mitigation: add `if (selRifs.length) params.rifs = selRifs.join(',');` inside applyFilters and also reset selRifs in the useEffect that runs on dialog open.
